name: Persona Reaction Panel
description: Pre-test an internal launch, comms, or enablement artefact against your own role-based personas before it ships — surfaces blackspots, domain gaps, credible-detractor risks, and concrete edits. Bring your own personas file.
author: Olivia Zhang
coverImageAlt: Five faceted role figures stand around a blank folded launch artifact under cyan and orange review light.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: A blank folded launch artifact stands before a semicircle of distinct faceted role figures, each casting a different colored reflection onto it, expressing a persona panel pressure-testing communications before release.
Scene/backdrop: A restrained editorial review chamber with a warm paper floor and slate background.
Subject: One central blank artifact, five clearly distinct abstract role figures on small plinths, and converging cyan reflections with one orange risk accent.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI or Microsoft Fluent branding
Correction: Widen and simplify the composition so the complete central artifact and all five full role figures with their plinths fit inside the inner 84% with a clearly empty border; make the figures empty-handed and remove all edge-touching forms.
